# 0. Setup

```{r packages}
library(did)

set.seed(42)

PATH_BATTERY_S1       <- "../data/battery_spec1_cs_ready.csv"
PATH_HYDROGEN_S1      <- "../data/hydrogen_spec1_cs_ready.csv"
PATH_BATTERY_FIRMS_S2  <- "../data/battery_spec2_matched_firms.csv"
PATH_HYDROGEN_FIRMS_S2 <- "../data/hydrogen_spec2_matched_firms.csv"
PATH_BATTERY_S2  <- "../data/battery_spec2_cs_ready.csv"
PATH_HYDROGEN_S2 <- "../data/hydrogen_spec2_cs_ready.csv"

dir.create("../results/composition", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# 1. Load & Prepare Data

```{r load-data}
load_cs <- function(path) {
  df <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$month <- as.Date(df$month)

  df$period <- as.integer(format(df$month, "%Y")) * 100 +
               as.integer(format(df$month, "%m"))

  df$g <- as.character(df$g)
  df$g[df$g == "" | df$g == "NA"] <- NA
  df$g_period <- ifelse(
    is.na(df$g), 0L,
    as.integer(format(as.Date(df$g), "%Y")) * 100 +
    as.integer(format(as.Date(df$g), "%m"))
  )

  df$firm_id <- as.integer(factor(df$Linkedin_name))

  # ── Reference outcome ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  df$log_collabs <- log1p(df$n_collabs)

  # ── Technology-focused collaborations ───────────────────────────────────────
  df$log_collabs_hydrogen <- log1p(df$n_collabs_hydrogen)
  df$log_collabs_battery  <- log1p(df$n_collabs_battery)

  # ── Cross-border collaborations ──────────────────────────────────────────
  df$log_collabs_eu_crossborder <- log1p(df$n_collabs_eu_crossborder)
  df$log_collabs_non_eu   <- log1p(df$n_collabs_non_eu) 
  df$log_collabs_domestic <- log1p(df$n_collabs_domestic)

  # ── Cross-sector collaborations ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  df$log_collabs_crosssector  <- log1p(df$n_collabs_crosssector)
  df$log_collabs_withinsector <- log1p(df$n_collabs_withinsector) #Placebo

  df
}

battery_s2  <- load_cs(PATH_BATTERY_S2)
hydrogen_s2 <- load_cs(PATH_HYDROGEN_S2)

cat("\nColumns in battery dataset:\n")
print(colnames(battery_s2))
cat("\nColumns in hydrogen dataset:\n")
print(colnames(hydrogen_s2))

cat("Battery S2: ", n_distinct(battery_s2$Linkedin_name),
    "firms,", n_distinct(battery_s2$period), "periods\n")
cat("Hydrogen S2:", n_distinct(hydrogen_s2$Linkedin_name),
    "firms,", n_distinct(hydrogen_s2$period), "periods\n")

# Zero-share diagnostics
cat("\n--- Zero shares for combined outcomes (treated firms only) ---\n")
outcome_cols <- c(
  "n_collabs",
  "n_collabs_battery",
  "n_collabs_hydrogen",
  "n_collabs_eu_crossborder",
  "n_collabs_crosssector",
  "n_collabs_withinsector",
  "n_collabs_non_eu",
  "n_collabs_domestic"
)

for (col in outcome_cols) {
  if (col %in% names(battery_s2)) {
    zs_b <- mean(battery_s2[battery_s2$is_treated == 1, col] == 0)
    zs_h <- mean(hydrogen_s2[hydrogen_s2$is_treated == 1, col] == 0)
    cat(sprintf("  %-30s  Battery treated: %.1f%%  Hydrogen treated: %.1f%%\n",
                col, zs_b * 100, zs_h * 100))
  }
}

# Baseline cross-sector share (treated vs control, 2020)
cat("\n--- Baseline cross-sector collab share (2020, treated vs control) ---\n")
for (tech in list(list(battery_s2, "Battery"),
                  list(hydrogen_s2, "Hydrogen"))) {
  df_check <- tech[[1]]
  lbl      <- tech[[2]]
  bl <- df_check %>%
    filter(format(month, "%Y") == "2020") %>%
    mutate(cs_share = ifelse(n_collabs > 0,
                             n_collabs_crosssector / n_collabs,
                             NA_real_)) %>%
    group_by(is_treated) %>%
    summarise(mean_cs_share = round(mean(cs_share, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
              .groups = "drop")
  cat(lbl, ":\n"); print(bl)
}
```

> **Note on zero shares:** Higher zero shares than total collaborations are expected for the more specific outcomes. C&S handles zeros via `log1p`. For outcomes exceeding roughly 85% zeros among treated firms, effects are best interpreted as extensive-margin changes.

> **Note on cross-sector construction:** Cross-sector collaborations use NACE 2-digit codes mapped from LinkedIn industry categories, restricted to value-chain-relevant industries present among IPCEI-treated firms. Firms outside this mapped set are excluded from both cross- and within-sector counts.

# 2. C&S Estimation — Helper Functions

```{r cs-function}

run_cs <- function(df, yname = "log_collabs", label = "",
                   control_group = "notyettreated",
                   clustervars   = NULL) {
  cat("\n=== C&S:", label, "===\n")
  cs_out <- att_gt(
    yname         = yname,
    tname         = "period",
    idname        = "firm_id",
    gname         = "g_period",
    control_group = control_group,
    clustervars   = clustervars,
    bstrap        = TRUE,
    biters        = 999,
    panel         = TRUE,
    pl            = TRUE,
    data          = df
  )
  print(summary(cs_out))
  cs_out
}

# ── Aggregators ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
agg_simple  <- function(cs_out) aggte(cs_out, type = "simple")

agg_dynamic <- function(cs_out) aggte(cs_out, type = "dynamic",
                                      min_e = -12, max_e = 24)

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pval_from_att <- function(att, se) {
  round(2 * pnorm(-abs(att / se)), 3)
}

sample_stats <- function(df, yname) {
  df_use <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[yname]]),
      !is.na(firm_id),
      !is.na(period),
      !is.na(g_period)
    )

  data.frame(
    N_obs     = nrow(df_use),
    N_units   = n_distinct(df_use$firm_id),
    N_treated = n_distinct(df_use$firm_id[df_use$g_period > 0]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# ── ATT row builder (UPDATED) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
make_att_row <- function(agg_obj, technology, outcome, type = "Primary S2",
                         cs_out = NULL, df = NULL, yname = NULL) {

  stats <- if (!is.null(df) && !is.null(yname)) {
    sample_stats(df, yname)
  } else {
    data.frame(N_obs = NA_integer_, N_units = NA_integer_, N_treated = NA_integer_)
  }

  data.frame(
    Technology       = technology,
    Outcome          = outcome,
    Type             = type,
    ATT              = round(agg_obj$overall.att, 4),
    SE               = round(agg_obj$overall.se,  4),
    p_value          = pval_from_att(agg_obj$overall.att, agg_obj$overall.se),
    pretrend_stat    = if (!is.null(cs_out) && !is.null(cs_out$W))     round(cs_out$W, 3)     else NA_real_,
    pretrend_p_value = if (!is.null(cs_out) && !is.null(cs_out$Wpval)) round(cs_out$Wpval, 3) else NA_real_,
    N_obs            = stats$N_obs,
    N_units          = stats$N_units,
    N_treated        = stats$N_treated,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# ── Plotting helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_cs <- function(agg_dyn, title) {
  ggdid(agg_dyn, title = title) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    labs(x = "Months relative to treatment", y = "ATT(g,t)")
}

make_plot_df <- function(agg_dyn, label) {
  data.frame(
    e       = agg_dyn$egt,
    att     = agg_dyn$att.egt,
    se      = agg_dyn$se.egt,
    cil     = agg_dyn$att.egt - 1.96 * agg_dyn$se.egt,
    ciu     = agg_dyn$att.egt + 1.96 * agg_dyn$se.egt,
    outcome = label
  )
}

make_combined_plot <- function(plot_df, title, ncol = 2) {
  ggplot(plot_df,
         aes(x = e, y = att, ymin = cil, ymax = ciu,
             colour = outcome, fill = outcome)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(~outcome, ncol = ncol, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    labs(title = title,
         x = "Months relative to treatment",
         y = "ATT(g,t)")
}
```

# 3. Combined Main Outcomes

## 3.1 Technology-Focused Collaborations

**Hypothesis:** IPCEI subsidises technology-specific R&D consortia directly, so treated firms should increase collaborations within their own technology domain more than matched controls.

```{r cs-tech}
cs_battery_tech  <- run_cs(battery_s2,
                           yname = "log_collabs_battery",
                           label = "Battery S2 — technology-focused collaborations")
cs_hydrogen_tech <- run_cs(hydrogen_s2,
                           yname = "log_collabs_hydrogen",
                           label = "Hydrogen S2 — technology-focused collaborations")

agg_battery_tech_simple  <- agg_simple(cs_battery_tech)
agg_hydrogen_tech_simple <- agg_simple(cs_hydrogen_tech)
agg_battery_tech_dyn     <- agg_dynamic(cs_battery_tech)
agg_hydrogen_tech_dyn    <- agg_dynamic(cs_hydrogen_tech)
```

```{r plot-tech}
p_tech_b <- plot_cs(agg_battery_tech_dyn,
                    "Battery IPCEI — Technology-focused collaborations")
p_tech_h <- plot_cs(agg_hydrogen_tech_dyn,
                    "Hydrogen IPCEI — Technology-focused collaborations")

print(p_tech_b)
print(p_tech_h)

ggsave("../results/composition/cs_battery_technologyfocused_eventstudy.pdf",
       p_tech_b, width = 10, height = 6)
ggsave("../results/composition/cs_hydrogen_technologyfocused_eventstudy.pdf",
       p_tech_h, width = 10, height = 6)
```

## 3.2 Cross-Border EU Collaborations

**Hypothesis:** IPCEI explicitly targets cross-border collaboration within the EU single market. Treated firms should increase collaborations with partners in other EU member states more than matched controls.

```{r cs-crossborder}
cs_battery_cb          <- run_cs(battery_s2,
                                 yname = "log_collabs_eu_crossborder",
                                 label = "Battery S2 — cross-border EU collaborations")
cs_hydrogen_cb         <- run_cs(hydrogen_s2,
                                 yname = "log_collabs_eu_crossborder",
                                 label = "Hydrogen S2 — cross-border EU collaborations")

agg_battery_cb_simple          <- agg_simple(cs_battery_cb)
agg_hydrogen_cb_simple         <- agg_simple(cs_hydrogen_cb)
agg_battery_cb_dyn             <- agg_dynamic(cs_battery_cb)
agg_hydrogen_cb_dyn            <- agg_dynamic(cs_hydrogen_cb)
```

```{r plot-crossborder}
p_cb_b   <- plot_cs(agg_battery_cb_dyn,
                    "Battery IPCEI — Cross-border EU collaborations")
p_cb_h   <- plot_cs(agg_hydrogen_cb_dyn,
                    "Hydrogen IPCEI — Cross-border EU collaborations")

print(p_cb_b);   print(p_cb_h)

ggsave("../results/composition/cs_battery_crossbordereu_eventstudy.pdf",
       p_cb_b, width = 10, height = 6)
ggsave("../results/composition/cs_hydrogen_crossbordereu_eventstudy.pdf",

```

## 3.3 Cross-Sector Collaborations

**Hypothesis:** IPCEI targets value-chain integration across sectors. Treated firms should increase collaborations with partners in different NACE 2-digit categories more than matched controls.

```{r cs-crosssector}

                         yname = "log_collabs_crosssector",
                         label = "Battery S2 — cross-sector collaborations")
cs_hydrogen_xs <- run_cs(hydrogen_s2,
                         yname = "log_collabs_crosssector",
                         label = "Hydrogen S2 — cross-sector collaborations")
cs_battery_ws  <- run_cs(battery_s2,
                         yname = "log_collabs_withinsector",
                         label = "Battery S2 — within-sector collaborations (placebo)")
cs_hydrogen_ws <- run_cs(hydrogen_s2,
                         yname = "log_collabs_withinsector",
                         label = "Hydrogen S2 — within-sector collaborations (placebo)")

agg_battery_xs_simple  <- agg_simple(cs_battery_xs)
agg_hydrogen_xs_simple <- agg_simple(cs_hydrogen_xs)

agg_hydrogen_ws_simple <- agg_simple(cs_hydrogen_ws)

agg_battery_xs_dyn     <- agg_dynamic(cs_battery_xs)
agg_hydrogen_xs_dyn    <- agg_dynamic(cs_hydrogen_xs)
agg_battery_ws_dyn     <- agg_dynamic(cs_battery_ws)
agg_hydrogen_ws_dyn    <- agg_dynamic(cs_hydrogen_ws)
```


# 5. Outcome Diagnostics

```{r power-diagnostics}
diagnose_outcomes <- function(df, tech_label) {

  outcomes <- c(
    "n_collabs",
    "n_collabs_battery",
    "n_collabs_hydrogen",
    "n_collabs_eu_crossborder",
    "n_collabs_crosssector",
    "n_collabs_non_eu",
    "n_collabs_domestic",
    "n_collabs_withinsector"
  )

  outcomes <- outcomes[outcomes %in% names(df)]

  res <- lapply(outcomes, function(v) {
    data.frame(
      Technology = tech_label,
      Outcome    = v,
      Mean       = round(mean(df[[v]], na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      SD         = round(sd(df[[v]], na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      ZeroShare  = round(mean(df[[v]] == 0, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  bind_rows(res)
}

battery_diag  <- diagnose_outcomes(battery_s2,  "Battery")
hydrogen_diag <- diagnose_outcomes(hydrogen_s2, "Hydrogen")
diag_table    <- bind_rows(battery_diag, hydrogen_diag)

cat("\n=== Outcome Diagnostics (Power Interpretation) ===\n")
print(diag_table, row.names = FALSE)

kable(diag_table,
      caption = "Outcome Distribution Diagnostics (Mean, SD, Zero Share)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)

write.csv(diag_table,
          "../results/composition/outcome_diagnostics.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# Treatment sample sizes

treated_battery  <- battery_s2 %>% filter(g_period > 0) %>% pull(firm_id) %>% unique() %>% length()
treated_hydrogen <- hydrogen_s2 %>% filter(g_period > 0) %>% pull(firm_id) %>% unique() %>% length()

cat("\n=== Treated Firms ===\n")
cat("Battery treated firms:", treated_battery, "\n")
cat("Hydrogen treated firms:", treated_hydrogen, "\n")
```

# 7. Power Simulation

Only the most substantively central outcomes are carried forward here: **technology-focused collaborations** and **cross-border EU collaborations**. Effect-size grid stays unchanged.

```{r power-function}
run_power_sim <- function(cs_data, outcome_var, att_true,
                          n_sims = 100, label = "") {
  controls_df   <- cs_data[cs_data$is_control == 1, ]
  control_names <- unique(controls_df$Linkedin_name)

  real_cohorts <- cs_data %>%
    filter(is_treated == 1) %>%
    distinct(Linkedin_name, g_period) %>%
    count(g_period) %>%
    arrange(g_period)

  results <- numeric(n_sims)

  for (i in seq_len(n_sims)) {
    available    <- control_names
    treated_pool <- character(0)
    g_vec        <- integer(0)

    for (k in seq_len(nrow(real_cohorts))) {
      n_k    <- real_cohorts$n[k]
      cohort <- real_cohorts$g_period[k]
      if (length(available) < n_k) break
      sampled      <- sample(available, n_k, replace = FALSE)
      available    <- setdiff(available, sampled)
      treated_pool <- c(treated_pool, sampled)
      g_vec        <- c(g_vec, rep(cohort, n_k))
    }

    g_lookup <- data.frame(Linkedin_name = treated_pool,
                           g_sim = g_vec,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    sim_treated <- controls_df %>%
      filter(Linkedin_name %in% treated_pool) %>%
      left_join(g_lookup, by = "Linkedin_name") %>%
      mutate(post_sim     = as.integer(period >= g_sim),
             outcome_sim  = .data[[outcome_var]] + att_true * post_sim,
             g_period_sim = g_sim)

    sim_controls <- controls_df %>%
      filter(Linkedin_name %in% available) %>%
      mutate(outcome_sim  = .data[[outcome_var]],
             g_period_sim = 0L)

    sim_data <- bind_rows(sim_treated, sim_controls) %>%
      mutate(firm_id_sim = as.integer(factor(Linkedin_name)))

    result <- tryCatch({
      cs_sim <- att_gt(
        yname         = "outcome_sim",
        tname         = "period",
        idname        = "firm_id_sim",
        gname         = "g_period_sim",
        control_group = "notyettreated",
        bstrap        = FALSE,
        panel         = TRUE,
        print_details = FALSE,
        data          = sim_data
      )
      agg_sim <- aggte(cs_sim, type = "simple")
      z_stat  <- agg_sim$overall.att / agg_sim$overall.se
      as.integer(abs(z_stat) > 1.96)
    }, error = function(e) NA_integer_)

    results[i] <- result
  }

  mean(results, na.rm = TRUE)
}
```

```{r power-run, cache=TRUE}
library(parallel)

att_grid <- log(1 + c(0.10, 0.20, 0.30))

cat("Running combined power simulations...\n")

power_b_tech <- unlist(mclapply(att_grid, function(a)
  run_power_sim(battery_s2,  "log_collabs_battery", a, 100, "B-tech"),
  mc.cores = 4))

power_h_tech <- unlist(mclapply(att_grid, function(a)
  run_power_sim(hydrogen_s2, "log_collabs_hydrogen", a, 100, "H-tech"),
  mc.cores = 4))

power_b_cb <- unlist(mclapply(att_grid, function(a)
  run_power_sim(battery_s2,  "log_collabs_eu_crossborder", a, 100, "B-cb"),
  mc.cores = 4))

power_h_cb <- unlist(mclapply(att_grid, function(a)
  run_power_sim(hydrogen_s2, "log_collabs_eu_crossborder", a, 100, "H-cb"),
  mc.cores = 4))

power_combined <- data.frame(
  att_pct     = round((exp(att_grid) - 1) * 100, 1),
  battery_tech  = power_b_tech,
  hydrogen_tech = power_h_tech,
  battery_cb    = power_b_cb,
  hydrogen_cb   = power_h_cb
)

print(power_combined)
write.csv(power_combined,
          "../results/composition/power_combined.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r export}
export_dynamic <- function(agg_dyn, label) {
  data.frame(
    e     = agg_dyn$egt,
    att   = agg_dyn$att.egt,
    se    = agg_dyn$se.egt,
    cil   = agg_dyn$att.egt - 1.96 * agg_dyn$se.egt,
    ciu   = agg_dyn$att.egt + 1.96 * agg_dyn$se.egt,
    label = label,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

# 9. Robustness Checks — Significant Channel Outcomes

Replicates balance specification, firm-level clustering, and never-treated
control group for the three significant or borderline significant outcomes:
battery technology-focused (p=0.025), hydrogen technology-focused (p=0.057),
and hydrogen cross-border EU (p=0.007).

```{r robustness-load-s1}
hydrogen_s1 <- load_cs(PATH_HYDROGEN_S1)
```

```{r bh-correction}
# ── Benjamini-Hochberg correction separately per technology ───────────────────
battery_p <- c(0.287, 0.025, 0.005, 0.304, 0.248, 0.366)
names(battery_p) <- c("Total collabs", "Technology-tagged", "Domestic",
                       "Cross-border EU", "Non-EU", "Cross-sector")

hydrogen_p <- c(0.178, 0.068, 0.916, 0.013, 0.031, 0.247)
names(hydrogen_p) <- c("Total collabs", "Technology-tagged", "Domestic",
                        "Cross-border EU", "Non-EU", "Cross-sector")

bh_battery  <- p.adjust(battery_p,  method = "BH")
bh_hydrogen <- p.adjust(hydrogen_p, method = "BH")

make_bh_df <- function(tech, p_raw, p_bh) {
  data.frame(
    technology = tech,
    outcome    = names(p_raw),
    p_raw      = round(p_raw, 3),
    p_bh       = round(p_bh,  3),
    sig_raw    = ifelse(p_raw < 0.01, "***",
                 ifelse(p_raw < 0.05, "**",
                 ifelse(p_raw < 0.10, "*", ""))),
    sig_bh     = ifelse(p_bh  < 0.01, "***",
                 ifelse(p_bh  < 0.05, "**",
                 ifelse(p_bh  < 0.10, "*", "")))
  )
}

bh_df <- rbind(
  make_bh_df("Battery",  battery_p,  bh_battery),
  make_bh_df("Hydrogen", hydrogen_p, bh_hydrogen)
)

cat("\n=== Benjamini-Hochberg Correction (per technology) ===\n")
print(bh_df, row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(bh_df,
          "../results/composition/bh_correction.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# 10. Rosenbaum Bounds Sensitivity Analysis

Applied to significant outcomes: battery technology-focused collabs (p=0.025)
and hydrogen cross-border EU collabs (p=0.007). Asks how strong unmeasured
confounding would need to be to explain away the result. Gamma = 1.5 means
treated firms could be 1.5x more likely to be selected due to unobserved
factors, conditional on all matched covariates.

Reference: Rosenbaum, P.R. (2002). Observational Studies (2nd ed.), Springer.
Package: rbounds — Keele, L. (2010). https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rbounds/

```{r rosenbaum-function}
run_rosenbaum <- function(matched_firms_path, cs_panel_path,
                           outcome_col = "n_collabs_battery",
                           gamma_max   = 3.0,
                           gamma_inc   = 0.1,
                           label       = "") {

  cat("\n=== Rosenbaum Bounds:", label, "===\n")

  firms <- read.csv(matched_firms_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  panel <- read.csv(cs_panel_path,      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  panel$month <- as.Date(panel$month)

  g_lookup <- panel %>%
    filter(is_treated == 1) %>%
    distinct(Linkedin_name, matched_to, g) %>%
    rename(g_treated = g)

  panel_sym <- panel %>%
    left_join(
      g_lookup %>% select(matched_to, g_treated),
      by = "matched_to"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      g_use  = ifelse(is_treated == 1, g, g_treated),
      g_date = as.Date(g_use),
      post   = !is.na(g_date) & month >= g_date
    ) %>%
    filter(post) %>%
    mutate(y = log1p(.data[[outcome_col]])) %>%
    group_by(Linkedin_name) %>%
    summarise(y_mean = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  firms <- firms %>%
    left_join(panel_sym, by = "Linkedin_name")

  treated <- firms %>%
    filter(is_treated == 1) %>%
    select(matched_to, Linkedin_name, y_treated = y_mean) %>%
    rename(treated_name = Linkedin_name)

  controls_agg <- firms %>%
    filter(is_control == 1) %>%
    group_by(matched_to) %>%
    summarise(y_control = mean(y_mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  pairs <- treated %>%
    left_join(controls_agg, by = "matched_to") %>%
    filter(!is.na(y_treated), !is.na(y_control))

  cat(sprintf("  Valid matched pairs: %d\n", nrow(pairs)))
  cat(sprintf("  Mean treated: %.3f | Mean control: %.3f\n",
              mean(pairs$y_treated), mean(pairs$y_control)))

  cat("\n-- Wilcoxon signed-rank sensitivity (psens) --\n")
  ps <- psens(pairs$y_treated, pairs$y_control,
              Gamma = gamma_max, GammaInc = gamma_inc)

  cat("\n-- Hodges-Lehmann sensitivity (hlsens) --\n")
  hl <- hlsens(pairs$y_treated, pairs$y_control,
               Gamma = gamma_max, GammaInc = gamma_inc)

  psens_df    <- as.data.frame(ps$bounds)
  gamma_break <- psens_df$Gamma[which(psens_df$`Lower Bound` > 0.05)[1]]

  cat(sprintf("\n  Lower bound p at Gamma=1: %.4f\n",
              psens_df$`Lower Bound`[1]))
  cat(sprintf("  Effect robust to hidden bias up to Gamma = %.1f\n",
              ifelse(is.na(gamma_break), gamma_max, gamma_break - gamma_inc)))

  invisible(list(psens = ps, hlsens = hl,
                 gamma_break = gamma_break, pairs = pairs))
}
```

```{r rosenbaum-run}
# Battery — technology-focused collabs (p=0.025)
rb_battery_tech <- run_rosenbaum(
  PATH_BATTERY_FIRMS_S2, PATH_BATTERY_S2,
  outcome_col = "n_collabs_battery",
  label       = "Battery S2 — technology-focused collabs"
)

# Hydrogen — technology-focused collabs (p=0.057)
rb_hydrogen_tech <- run_rosenbaum(
  PATH_HYDROGEN_FIRMS_S2, PATH_HYDROGEN_S2,
  outcome_col = "n_collabs_hydrogen",
  label       = "Hydrogen S2 — technology-focused collabs"
)

# Hydrogen — cross-border EU collabs (p=0.007)
rb_hydrogen_cb <- run_rosenbaum(
  PATH_HYDROGEN_FIRMS_S2, PATH_HYDROGEN_S2,
  outcome_col = "n_collabs_eu_crossborder",
  label       = "Hydrogen S2 — cross-border EU collabs"
)

# Hydrogen — non-EU collabs (p=0.020)
rb_hydrogen_noneu <- run_rosenbaum(
  PATH_HYDROGEN_FIRMS_S2, PATH_HYDROGEN_S2,
  outcome_col = "n_collabs_non_eu",
  label       = "Hydrogen S2 — non-EU collabs"
)
```

```{r rosenbaum-table}
make_rb_table <- function(rb_obj, label) {
  df <- as.data.frame(rb_obj$psens$bounds)
  df$Specification <- label
  df %>% select(Specification, everything())
}

rb_table <- bind_rows(
  make_rb_table(rb_battery_tech,   "Battery — technology-focused collabs"),
  make_rb_table(rb_hydrogen_tech,  "Hydrogen — technology-focused collabs"),
  make_rb_table(rb_hydrogen_cb,    "Hydrogen — cross-border EU collabs"),
  make_rb_table(rb_hydrogen_noneu, "Hydrogen — non-EU collabs")
) %>%
  filter(Gamma %in% c(1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0))

kable(rb_table, digits = 3,
      caption = "Rosenbaum Bounds Sensitivity Analysis") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "P-value bounds" = 2))

write.csv(rb_table,
          "../results/composition/rosenbaum_bounds_table.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```


---

# Notes

- **Primary spec only (S2):** retains the same estimation setup as the separate channel and spillover files.
- **Main reporting labels:** Technology-focused collaborations, Cross-sector collaborations, Cross-border EU collaborations, and Non-EU collaborations.
- **Secondary checks retained:** `n_collabs_withinsector` as placebo.
- **Power section trimmed:** effect-size grid unchanged, but simulations and plotting now focus only on technology-focused and cross-border EU collaborations.
- **Exports:** shared ATT and event-study CSVs are cleaned before appending, so re-runs should not duplicate legacy channel/spillover labels.
- **Estimator:** Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021), `control_group = "notyettreated"`, 999 bootstrap iterations, no covariate adjustment.
